findings.observed: python app/app.py add todo → stdout 'added: todo', exit 0; subsequent python app/app.py list shows only the two pre-existing tasks ('buy milk', 'walk dog'). Reproduced 3/3 with 'todo', 'po-obs-probe-1', 'todo'; list output never changes (28B every time). Directory snapshot shows no data file created and no mtime change in app/ after an add.
findings.expected_basis: Product's own feedback contradicts its own observable state ('added: todo' vs list output); packet purpose: 'A user can list tasks and add one with the Tasks CLI'; README v2 documents both behaviors as current.
findings.reproduction: 1) python app/app.py list  -> two tasks; 2) python app/app.py add todo -> 'added: todo' exit 0; 3) python app/app.py list -> 'todo' absent. Repeat with any name.

findings.observed: python app/app.py add (missing argument) → stdout 'added: None', exit 0, stderr empty.
findings.expected_basis: Product's own usage line says 'add <task>'; confirming a successful add of no task is false success feedback and would pollute task state if persistence worked.

findings.observed: python app/app.py add buy milk → stderr 'app.py: error: unrecognized arguments: milk', exit 2. Quoted form works ('added: buy milk'). The seeded list itself contains the two-word task 'buy milk', which cannot be re-added unquoted.
findings.expected_basis: The product's own example data demonstrates multi-word task names as normal content, yet the natural unquoted input fails with an argparse usage dump.
findings.reproduction: python app/app.py add buy milk → exit 2 'unrecognized arguments: milk'; compare: python app/app.py add "buy milk" → exit 0.

findings.observed: Unknown command ('frobnicate'), uppercase 'LIST', and bare invocation all print the usage line to STDOUT with exit 0, while bad flags (--help/-h) error to STDERR with exit 2. A script cannot detect a typo'd command via exit code.
findings.expected_basis: Internal inconsistency in the product's own error contract: argparse-level errors use exit 2/stderr; command-level errors use exit 0/stdout.
findings.reproduction: python app/app.py frobnicate → exit 0, usage on stdout; python app/app.py --help → exit 2, usage on stderr.

findings.observed: --help and -h are rejected: 'app.py: error: unrecognized arguments: --help', exit 2. The only usage discovery paths are bare invocation and error output.
findings.expected_basis: Convention for CLI products; product exposes no documented help surface (README documents only list/add; usage line surfaces only via errors).

findings.observed: python app/app.py list extra → normal list output, exit 0; the stray argument is silently ignored, while add is argparse-strict about extra tokens.
findings.expected_basis: Inconsistent argument strictness between the product's two commands (compare F-003 behavior on add).
findings.reproduction: python app/app.py list extra → list renders, exit 0.

harness_notes: Initial unicode 'mojibake' (j3-a15) was proven to be the observer harness's file decoding (PS 5.1 ANSI default), not product behavior: byte-exact UTF-8 read of the re-run shows correct 'added: 任务测试' (j3-a15b). No unicode finding recorded.

Two empty-string add attempts (j3-a16, j3-a16b) failed due to observer shell quoting (cmd quote collapse, then --% stop-parsing swallowing redirections). Observation-cycle cap reached for that action; the input class is covered by the missing-argument case (F-002). Evidence files intentionally absent.

PS 5.1 wraps native stderr as error records when redirected; stream separation for later runs was done via cmd /c for clean capture. PowerShell error-record noise in j1-a3*.err is harness rendering around genuine product stderr lines.
Source code (app/app.py) was never read; state probes used CLI output and directory metadata only.
stop_reason: coverage-complete: every surface advertised by the product (README: list/add; product usage line: --smoke, usage/help, error paths) was exercised; critical finding F-001 remains unresolved and routes to the repair loop per finding-rules.
